Definition: from G1342 and G2920; a just sentence:--righteous judgment.
BiblicalUsage: Righteous judgment, God's sentence that is just and not arbitrary, and Paul warns that a hard heart stores up wrath against the day when that judgment is revealed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's judgment is righteous through and through, which is exactly why I want mercy to meet me there instead of my own record.
